name: databox-executive-dashboard
description: Auto-discovers connected Databox data sources, curates executive-level KPIs by role and 90-day priority, and generates a complete dashboard blueprint with an Executive Intelligence Brief. Filters out analyst noise. Built for mid-market professional services CEOs, COOs, CFOs, and sales leaders.
author: Revenue Institute

tools.name: databox_validate_connection
tools.description: Validate a Databox API key and list accessible accounts. Run this first.

tools.name: databox_discover_data_sources
tools.description: Inventory all data sources connected to a Databox account (HubSpot, QuickBooks, Google Ads, etc.).

tools.name: databox_build_executive_dashboard
tools.description: Core tool. Discovers metrics, curates by executive role and priority, loads current values, and returns an Executive Intelligence Brief + complete Databoard blueprint.

tools.name: databox_get_metric_intel
tools.description: Ask a natural language question against Databox data via Genie AI. Requires MCP token.

triggers: what metrics should a CEO track in databox
